traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements in docs/stories/010.3-DEV-MIGRATE-TO-SUPPORTS.story.md are implemented and verified: - The `traceability/prefer-implements-annotation` rule is implemented with optional, configurable warnings and conservative auto-fix behavior, only active when users opt in (default off). - Auto-fix converts simple single-story `@story` + multiple `@req` annotations into a single `@supports` line, preserving JSDoc structure and formatting, and avoids fixing complex or ambiguous patterns while still warning. - Multi-story and mixed @story/@req/@supports scenarios are detected and reported with appropriate messages, without unsafe fixes. - Legacy `@story`/`@req` annotations remain valid when this rule is disabled, satisfying backward-compatibility requirements. - Tests explicitly tied to this story cover all key behaviors (warnings, auto-fix, multi-story detection, backward compatibility, configuration severity), and the full test suite passes. - User-facing migration documentation describes this rule, its default disabled state, opt-in configuration, and its auto-fix role in migrating from `@story`/`@req` to `@supports`.
Based on concrete implementation, tests, and documentation, this story is fully implemented.
